course_name_en: MABM110 – Human Resource Management and Management

learning_outcomes.text: Students can apply central concepts of human resource management and corporate management by using mindsets and tools of human resource management, as well as methods of financial accounting and business plan development, to make informed business decisions and professionally design personnel and founding processes.

In the area of human resource management, students are able to apply central concepts and methods of human resource management by using mindsets and tools of human resource management and by employing common instruments of personnel development and selection. They work in particular with human resource department employees to develop requirement profiles and personality traits for positions, and apply their competencies in conducting personnel interviews from applicant and company perspectives to make informed decisions in application and selection processes and to design professional and targeted personnel processes.

In the area of corporate management and business plan, students are able to analyze business contexts and prepare integrated decisions by applying instruments of financial accounting, cost accounting, investment appraisal, and financing analysis within the framework of a business plan, to plan company formations, evaluate financing alternatives, and make economically viable decisions. They independently assess investments and forms of financing and perform price calculations for products.

syllabus_topics: Selected business elements of a business plan
Decision criteria for choosing the legal form of companies
Business idea: Products and services / Industry: Market and competition
Cost and price calculation, pricing, pricing policy

Overview of financing types: internal financing, external financing, credit financing, leasing, factoring, forfaiting, venture capital, business angels, crowdfunding, subsidies and grants, credit collaterals
Elements of the financial plan / investment / capital requirement plan, liquidity plan, projected profit and loss statement, projected balance sheet
Business key figures: key figures for asset structure, key figures for financial position, key figures for earnings position

assessment_methods.method: Unscored written assignment/homework (Study achievement XS/1S Human Resource Management)
Exam (45 min) or oral examination (20 min) (Corporate Management/Business Plan)

assessment_rules: Student knowledge is assessed based on an unscored written assignment/homework (study achievement XS/1S Human Resource Management) and an exam (45 min) or an oral exam of 20 min (Corporate Management/Business Plan). The form of examination in the Corporate Management/Business Plan course will be announced by the lecturer at the beginning of the semester.
